newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope presides at Holy Thursday service.
newsitem.headline: Pope presides at Holy Thursday service.

text.p: Pope John Paul, who has suffered from poor health in recent years, began the hectic four-day Holy Week programme on Thursday looking in relatively good form.

The 76-year-old Pontiff, dressed in gold and white vestments, presided over a Holy Thursday service in St Peter's Basilica before a congregation of some 10,000, including many cardinals, bishops and priests.
